notes: Hunger, thirst and predators with no win condition is Survival's resource-attrition mode, so Resource Survival is the preset even though its usual world-biomes shape does not apply — the answer says a few connected city blocks, so I substituted space-bounded, which keeps the threat and the cat in proximity and holds the build on P0 instead of world-biomes' P4. Stray dogs and other predators are spawner-npc, an actor threat with an origin and patrol ground rather than a hazard region, and the drains, gaps and wrecks a cat squeezes into are cover-los; the decades-overgrown blocks themselves are settlement-density. Deciding without a user: food and water sources are both survival resource nodes rather than a water body, the base-building option was dropped because nothing in the prompt has the cat building anything, and no escape gate exists on purpose since the answer says you survive as long as you can. Building interiors were set aside — nothing states the cat goes inside, so the ruined buildings are facades and the P3 that would add is deferred rather than assumed.
